overview_description.description: Seez is a data-first retail platform for automotive buying and selling services. The Seez mobile app for car shoppers offers a smart search engine for online car listings, as well as proprietary, AI-powered tools, and services that make the car shopping journey faster, easier, and more efficient. Seez is an AI-powered automotive technology platform helping car dealerships digitize sales, improve customer experience, and manage online-to-offline car buying journeys.

about_short_description.short_description: Seez is an AI-driven automotive platform helps car dealerships manage online listings, generate leads and improve digital sales efficiency.

product.name: Seez SaaS Suite
product.description: A suite of software products that integrate online and physical dealership operations to support car sales.

product.name: Digital Buying Flow
product.description: A platform feature that enables customers to complete car purchases online or in-store with integrated financing and insurance options.

product.name: Showroom Platform
product.description: A platform for dealership staff to manage orders, inventory, customer relationships, and sales tasks in one system.

product.name: Showroom Platform AI-Powered Assistant (Seezar)
product.description: A 24/7 AI assistant that provides personalized sales advice by integrating automotive data and dealership systems.

product.name: SeezNitro
product.description: An AI-driven analytics platform that evaluates car listings for attractiveness, optimizes inventory, and provides customer insights.

product.name: SeezBoost
product.description: An AI-powered marketing platform that creates dynamic ads, offers personalized recommendations, and provides analytics for dealerships.
